description: Source code implementing encoding and conversion functions for GeneralizedTime and UTC time in the net::der namespace, including functions to encode time as GeneralizedTime, convert between time formats, and handle time serialization.

methods.name: WriteFourDigit
methods.description: Writes a four-digit number into a 4-byte array, returns false if value >= 10000.

methods.name: WriteTwoDigit
methods.description: Writes a two-digit number into a 2-byte array, returns false if value >= 100.

methods.name: EncodeTimeAsGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Encodes a base::Time object into a GeneralizedTime structure.

methods.name: EncodePosixTimeAsGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Converts a POSIX timestamp to GeneralizedTime.

methods.name: GeneralizedTimeToPosixTime
methods.description: Converts a GeneralizedTime to POSIX timestamp.

methods.name: EncodeGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Encodes a GeneralizedTime into a fixed-length byte array.

methods.name: EncodeUTCTime
methods.description: Encodes a GeneralizedTime into a UTC time byte array.
